Crazy times. This morning, while getting breakfast, I instructed Gemini to write a Python script that connects to my Spotify, pulls my liked songs, and uses Gemini to recommend more songs.

Take the script from here if you want it: https://t.co/bMaoS9ZFiY

SPOTIPY_CLIENT_ID='get it from https://t.co/vEv14kEpma'
SPOTIPY_CLIENT_SECRET='get it from https://t.co/vEv14kEpma'
SPOTIPY_REDIRECT_URI='http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback'
OPENROUTER_API_KEY='get it from https://t.co/Sr9Lf9pxPC'

Run in the console:
